Process_Function: CNC laser cut Polycarbonate panels & mill AL6061 fin plates
Potential_Failure_Mode: Micro-cracks, burrs, or dimensional mismatch (> 0.5mm) on cutouts
Potential_Failure_Effects: Air leaks around chimney, binding post loose fit, cracked plastic panel
Potential_Causes: Feed rate too fast, incorrect laser power setting, dull CNC milling bit
Current_Process_Controls_Prevention: Machine tool calibration and test cut on scrap piece
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Vernier caliper 100% dimensional check and edge optical inspection
Recommended_Action: Use specialized single-flute plastic endmill; anneal laser-cut edges; verify cutouts against go/no-go acrylic gauge
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Laser cutting parameters calibrated; edge tolerance < 0.15mm

Process_Function: Apply Arctic MX-4 thermal compound on TPA3116 chips
Potential_Failure_Mode: Uneven paste spread, air voids, or paste dry-out (> 50 micron layer)
Potential_Failure_Effects: Elevated thermal resistance (> 3.5°C/W), localized hot spot, thermal throttling
Potential_Causes: Improper dot dispensing pattern, inadequate clamping pressure on PCB
Current_Process_Controls_Prevention: Operator visual estimation of thermal paste blob size
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Post-clamping squeeze-out visual inspection and thermal camera soak test
Recommended_Action: Standardize on "X-pattern" micro-dispensing (0.05g per chip); torque-controlled M3 nylon clamping standoffs (0.35 N·m)
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Calibrated thermal syringe dispensing and uniform screw torque

Process_Function: Hand solder 10-pad terminals on XH-M562 boards & dev headers
Potential_Failure_Mode: Solder bridge between adjacent pads (Pads 4/5 or 8/9) or cold joint
Potential_Failure_Effects: Short circuit on 24V rail, speaker BTL short to GND, high contact resistance
Potential_Causes: Excess solder feed, iron tip too wide, dwelling > 5s on pad, oxidation
Current_Process_Controls_Prevention: Standard rosin-core solder and manual soldering iron
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: 10x magnifying loupe visual inspection & DMM continuity probe
Recommended_Action: Use 0.8mm 63/37 leaded solder, temperature-controlled iron at 350°C, strict 3-second dwell rule, backlight inspection jig
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Backlight bridge check jig + DMM adjacent-pad resistance test

Process_Function: Strip and insert 16/20 AWG wires into WAGO 221-415 blocks
Potential_Failure_Mode: Wire strip length out of spec (< 10mm or > 12mm), loose wire strand
Potential_Failure_Effects: Exposed live conductor shorting, high resistance joint, wire slip-out
Potential_Causes: Manual stripping without calibrated wire stripper or length guide
Current_Process_Controls_Prevention: Visual check against WAGO housing molded gauge mark
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Post-insertion pull test (pull-force > 30N) and rear test port probing
Recommended_Action: Use automatic calibrated wire stripper with built-in 11mm mechanical stop; verify lever snaps 100% flat
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Calibrated wire stripper with fixed 11mm stop; 100% pull test

Process_Function: Crimp JST-XH terminals and prepare 2-core shielded audio cable
Potential_Failure_Mode: Loose crimp pin, open circuit, nicked drain wire, broken shield braid
Potential_Failure_Effects: Audio channel dropout, ground loop hum, intermittent crackling
Potential_Causes: Improper crimp die size, excessive operator hand pressure, wire tension
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Tug test on crimp pin and DMM pin-to-pin loop resistance check
Recommended_Action: Use calibrated ratcheting crimper with exact AWG die; slide 2:1 dual-wall heat-shrink over shield ground drain transition
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Calibrated ratcheting die + heat-shrink strain relief

Process_Function: Press-fit and bolt 12x JS-910B binding posts in Polycarbonate
Potential_Failure_Mode: Loose binding post rotation, stripped M8 plastic threads, cracked panel
Potential_Failure_Effects: Terminal spins when tightening speaker cable, inter-terminal short
Potential_Causes: Over-torquing metal nuts on plastic panel without torque limiter
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Torque wrench inspection and manual rotational torque verification
Recommended_Action: Use double nylon lock washers; apply torque-limiting nut runner preset to 0.8 N·m; press-fit flat keyed D-hole profile
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: D-shaped anti-rotation cutouts and calibrated 0.8 N·m torque

Process_Function: Trim XL4015 buck converter multi-turn pot to 5.00V output
Potential_Failure_Mode: Output voltage set incorrectly (> 5.5V or < 4.75V) before connecting loads
Potential_Failure_Effects: Overvoltage destruction of ESP32 and DACs, or brownout boot failure
Potential_Causes: Operator forgets to trim under 24V input or reads incorrect multimeter scale
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Two-stage power-up protocol: verify 5.00V on bench BEFORE connecting loads
Recommended_Action: Mandatory two-stage assembly work instruction: lock trimmer with green Loctite 290 threadlocker after measuring 5.00V ± 0.05V
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Sign-off checklist required before connecting 5V harness to ESP32

Process_Function: Flash ESP32-S3 firmware with volume limiter and I2S registers
Potential_Failure_Mode: Incorrect firmware branch flashed or volume ceiling limiter disabled
Potential_Failure_Effects: TPA3116 driven into 10% THD clipping; PSU overload (> 250W); fan starts
Potential_Causes: Operator flashing wrong build target or corrupted non-volatile settings
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Serial monitor diagnostic verification of boot log settings
Recommended_Action: Single master automated flash script with checksum verification; hardcoded 83.6% voltage ceiling compiled into binary firmware
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Firmware binary verified with SHA256 checksum during bench flash

Process_Function: Perform electrical continuity and ground isolation test protocol
Potential_Failure_Mode: Power applied while short circuit or BTL-to-chassis fault exists
Potential_Failure_Effects: Smoked components, blown SMPS fuse, permanent damage to prototype
Potential_Causes: Rushing assembly sequence, skipping pre-power test checklist
Current_Process_Controls_Detection: Mandatory 6-step resistance sign-off before mains power cable attached
Recommended_Action: Implement physical lock-out tag on mains IEC inlet until all 6 resistance checkpoints (> 10k bus, < 0.1 ground) are verified and signed
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Quality gate checklist attached to chassis before first power

Process_Function: Run 6-channel full load sweep at 70% power into 4 ohm dummy loads
Potential_Failure_Mode: High harmonic distortion, channel imbalance, excessive thermal rise
Severity: Defective batch capacitor, cold solder joint failing under thermal stress
Occurrence: Acoustic sweep generator and 6x 100W 4 ohm load bank
Current_Process_Controls_Prevention: Audio analyzer THD measurement and FLIR thermal camera recording
Initial_RPN: Automated 30-minute burn-in sequence: log thermal equilibrium (< 52°C) and THD+N (< 0.05%) on all 6 channels simultaneously
Recommended_Action: Implemented: 30-min burn-in test station with automated pass/fail report
